integrated_multimodal_description: <Picture 1> Cinematic, live-action, Static Shot: a medium close-up from the side of a man with short dark hair and a trimmed beard (S1) sitting up in bed in a room bathed in warm, golden morning light. His four fingers wrap around the back of the phone and his thumb is hidden behind it, on the screen side. Behind him a sheer white curtain glows softly with sunlight against the teal wall. The camera remains perfectly fixed throughout the shot. His thumb stays hidden behind the phone and does not move; he does not scroll. At 00:04.000, with the smallest nod, the thumb comes down and presses the screen once: a single, firm, deliberate tap. After the tap the thumb stays down, hidden behind the phone, and never rises again; the hand holds the phone perfectly still until the end. Right after the tap, from 00:04.200, a small, satisfied, closed-lip smile spreads across his face, and he keeps looking at the phone, content and at ease. The thumb is softly lit by the dim glow of the screen and keeps the same warm brown skin tone as his fingers. The phone never turns: its back stays toward the camera for the entire shot. S1 is the only person in the frame. All movements are natural, subtle and unhurried, with realistic skin texture and soft natural light.
